desc: Implement forward lazy segment tree over initial ratings 1..500000 with range add and subtree maximum queries.
Implement boundary searches: first position with value >= L_i and first position with value > R_i, handling empty intervals correctly.
Process all N contests by applying +1 to the affected initial-rating interval.
Read Q queries and output final ratings for each initial X.
Test sample tests and edge cases: no affected interval, full-range updates, ratings exceeding 500000, and maximum constraints.
